female.sp: Original xvb-xd Farsia from Gundam AGE, not Fawn Farsia. The attached official mobile suit reference controls the pink petal-shaped armor, dark charcoal undersuit, pale inset panels, round magenta chest emitter, narrow single central head crest, small pointed shoulder shells, split long petal hip plates, pointed forearm armor, compact rear equipment and pink Farsia Base beneath the feet. Translate the helmet into an open sensor ornament framing a fully human uncovered face; no robot face or Gundam V-fin. Preserve exactly FIVE small flower-shaped Farsia remote bits clustered near the shoulders and upper back, mechanically distinct from the body, not real flowers. Keep the compact faceted pink propulsion base under both feet, shown in shallow perspective so it does not make the woman tiny. A beautiful poisonous flower is the mood only: soft rounded adult Japanese face, slightly downturned crimson eyes and a small knowing closed-mouth smile. Rich rose-brown long voluminous waves and curtain bangs, clearly an original adult woman in her 20s with mature anatomy, no resemblance to the pilot. Sensual fitted wearable pink armor: secure opaque breast coverage around the circular chest emitter with visible upper cleavage, bare waist and side abdomen, opaque high-cut pelvic base, split petal hip plates opened at the front to reveal human upper thighs while preserving their elongated pointed outer silhouette. Keep shoulder shells attached. Exactly two normal human arms and two legs; normal human elbows, wrists, five-fingered hands, knees, calves, ankles and human-foot-shaped boots. Mechanical petal shapes are armor outside her body, never extra joints or elongated biological limbs. Preserve one stowed rear sword, do not invent a magical staff. Large close full-body vertical composition, minimal headroom and minimal empty side and floor margin. Keep the woman visually dominant, do not shrink her for the floating bits or base. Generator default background. No literal flowers growing from skin, wings, childlike proportions, text or watermark.
